mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% does not correlate with subsequent FEDFUNDS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decrease does not correlate with subsequent increases in consumer spending (RSAFS).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns do not show a significant positive trend following sustained increases in HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate reduced economic output.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decrease does not correlate with subsequent negative economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.3% MoM, it signals a tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent monetary tightening.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% MoM and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% MoM, it signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% MoM AND UNRATE decreases > 0.3% MoM
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of RSAFS and UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three months signals a strengthening labor market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns do not show a significant positive trend following sustained increases in PAYEMS.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) increases by more than 1% MoM and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1%, it signals a supply-side expansion in a low-interest-rate environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of INDPRO and FEDFUNDS does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.
